english: Each decision is a row the game core wrote the moment it was taken (log.playerbot_equip, log.playerbot_listing); the names in `…` are the codes of playerbot_explain_rules.h and the overlay's constants. An equipment change: the pass puts on a piece whose score (TERM_TOTAL) beats the worn one's by SWAP_MARGIN_PERMILLE per mille, and a piece it took off within the hour only by SWAP_BACK_MARGIN_PERCENT percent. A weapon's score is its blow x1000 (TERM_BLOW_X1000, the model of GetPlayerBotWeaponHitDamageAt: the attack grade on foot, the weapon's roll, the plus's attack, a monster's defence at the bot's level, average and skill damage, mt2009's hidden bonus by the weapon's level) with Iwakura's tier on the blow alone, and beside it the class's preference and the fixed lines; the rest of the gear's is defence, lines and stones times the family's tier. A counter line: the price's steps in the order the pricing takes them - Iwakura's sheet at the yang rate and the inflation, the lines, the sale memory, the market ledger, the step limit, the keeper's spread, the floors, the rounding. The flags are the core's, the anomalies the panel's.
polski: Każda decyzja to wiersz zapisany przez rdzeń gry w chwili jej podjęcia (log.playerbot_equip, log.playerbot_listing); nazwy w `…` to kody z playerbot_explain_rules.h i stałe nakładki. Zmiana ekwipunku: przegląd zakłada rzecz, której wynik (TERM_TOTAL) przewyższa noszoną o SWAP_MARGIN_PERMILLE promili, a rzecz zdjętą w ciągu godziny dopiero o SWAP_BACK_MARGIN_PERCENT procent. Wynik broni to jej cios ×1000 (TERM_BLOW_X1000, model GetPlayerBotWeaponHitDamageAt: stopień ataku na piechotę, rzut broni, atak z plusa, obrona potwora na poziomie bota, średnie obrażenia i obrażenia umiejętności, ukryty bonus poziomu broni mt2009) ze stopniem Iwakury tylko na ciosie, i obok preferencja klasy i stałe bonusy; reszty ekwipunku — obrona, bonusy i kamienie razy stopień rodziny. Linia lady: kroki ceny w kolejności wyceny — arkusz Iwakury ze stawką yang i inflacją, bonusy, pamięć sprzedaży, rejestr rynku, ogranicznik kroku, rozrzut sprzedawcy, progi, zaokrąglenie. Flagi zapisał rdzeń, anomalie wyliczył panel.
translation: 각 결정은 결정 순간 게임 코어가 기록한 행입니다 (log.playerbot_equip, log.playerbot_listing). `…` 안의 이름은 playerbot_explain_rules.h의 코드와 오버레이 상수입니다. 장비 교체: 점검은 점수(TERM_TOTAL)가 착용 장비보다 SWAP_MARGIN_PERMILLE 퍼밀 높은 장비를 착용하고, 1시간 안에 벗은 장비는 SWAP_BACK_MARGIN_PERCENT 퍼센트만 높아도 됩니다. 무기 점수는 타격 x1000입니다 (TERM_BLOW_X1000, GetPlayerBotWeaponHitDamageAt 모델: 도보 공격 등급, 무기 판정, 강화 공격력, 봇 레벨의 몬스터 방어력, 평균·스킬 피해, 무기 레벨에 따른 mt2009 숨겨진 보너스). 이와쿠라 등급은 타격에만 적용되고, 옆에 직업 선호와 고정 옵션이 있습니다. 나머지 장비는 방어력, 옵션, 정령석에 계열 등급을 곱합니다. 노점 행: 가격 산정 순서대로의 단계 - 냥 비율과 인플레이션을 적용한 이와쿠라 시세표, 옵션, 판매 기록, 시장 장부, 단계 제한, 관리자 가격 폭, 최저가, 반올림. 플래그는 코어의 것, 이상 징후는 패널의 것입니다.

translation: 인벤토리가 가득 찼어 — 플레이어에게 공간을 비워 달라고 해. 🎒 (서버에 인벤토리 페이지가 더 있으면 {conf}의 "inventory_slots"를 올려.)
notes: T['inv_full'] | keep: {conf} | the classic web panel (browser, UTF-8: any letter)

english: 🙂 {name} isn't in game right now, and this action only works while they're online. Nothing was changed — ask them to log in and try again.
polski: 🙂 {name} nie jest teraz w grze, a ta akcja działa tylko, gdy gracz jest online. Nic nie zmieniono — poproś o zalogowanie i spróbuj ponownie.

notes: T['ingame_timeout'] | keep: {name} | the classic web panel (browser, UTF-8: any letter)

english: ✅ Written to {name}'s account — it appears the next time they log in.
polski: ✅ Zapisano na koncie gracza {name} — pojawi się przy następnym zalogowaniu.

polski: ⛔ Nic w grze nie odpowiedziało, więc {name} nie został przeniesiony i nic nie zmieniono. Teleport i szybkość biegu działają tylko na zalogowanej postaci, na serwerze z uruchomionym pomocnikiem w grze.

notes: T['ingame_nohelper'] | keep: {name} | the classic web panel (browser, UTF-8: any letter)

english: ✅ {name} wasn't in game right now — it was applied to their account and will be ready when they log in! 🎉
polski: ✅ {name} nie był teraz w grze — zapisano na koncie i będzie gotowe po zalogowaniu! 🎉
translation: ✅ {name}은(는) 게임에 없었어 — 계정에 적용했으니 접속하면 준비돼 있을 거야! 🎉
notes: T['act_offline'] | keep: {name} | the classic web panel (browser, UTF-8: any letter)

english: ⛔ {name} is in the game right now, so nothing was written to the database — the game would overwrite it. Try again: while the character plays, it gets the change at once.
polski: ⛔ {name} jest teraz w grze, więc nic nie zapisano w bazie — gra nadpisałaby zmianę. Spróbuj ponownie: będąc w grze, postać dostanie ją od razu.

notes: T['act_flush_online'] | keep: {name} | the classic web panel (browser, UTF-8: any letter)

english: ⛔ The database server did not confirm it let go of {name} ({status}), so nothing was written — the change would have been lost at the next login anyway. Try again in a moment.
polski: ⛔ Serwer bazy nie potwierdził zapomnienia postaci {name} ({status}), więc nic nie zapisano — zmiana i tak by przepadła przy następnym logowaniu. Spróbuj za chwilę.

notes: T['act_flush_failed'] | keep: {name} {status} | the classic web panel (browser, UTF-8: any letter)

english: ✅ Written to {name}'s account, but the game did not confirm the database server let go of the character. If the server is running and the character played in the last few minutes, the change may revert at the next login — then restart the server and make it again.
polski: ✅ Zapisano na koncie gracza {name}, ale gra nie potwierdziła, że serwer bazy zapomniał tę postać. Jeśli serwer działa, a postać grała w ostatnich minutach, zmiana może wrócić do poprzedniej przy logowaniu — wtedy zrestartuj serwer i zrób ją jeszcze raz.
translation: ✅ {name}의 계정에 기록했지만, 데이터베이스 서버가 캐릭터를 놓아줬는지 게임이 확인하지 않았어. 서버가 돌아가고 캐릭터가 최근 몇 분 안에 플레이했다면 다음 로그인 때 되돌아갈 수 있어 — 그러면 서버를 재시작하고 다시 해.
notes: T['act_flush_unanswered'] | keep: {name} | the classic web panel (browser, UTF-8: any letter)

english: ✅ Just in time! {name} picked it up in game while we were waiting, so it was applied there — not twice. 🎉
polski: ✅ W samą porę! {name} odebrał to w grze, gdy czekaliśmy, więc zastosowano tam — nie dwa razy. 🎉
translation: ✅ 딱 맞췄어! 기다리는 동안 {name}이(가) 게임에서 받아서 거기서 적용됐어 — 두 번은 아니야. 🎉
notes: T['act_late_done'] | keep: {name} | the classic web panel (browser, UTF-8: any letter)

english: ℹ️ The in-game helper took this over while we were waiting (status: {status}), so nothing was applied twice. Please check {name} and try again if needed.
polski: ℹ️ Pomocnik w grze przejął to, gdy czekaliśmy (stan: {status}), więc nic nie zastosowano dwa razy. Sprawdź gracza {name} i w razie potrzeby spróbuj ponownie.

translation: 예상치 못한 문제가 생겼어. 다시 해 보고, 계속되면 서버를 설치한 사람에게 알려 줘. 🙏

english: Everything current is there first: what changed in the last update, when the server is down for maintenance, and the people who can answer a question faster than you can search for it. Found a bug? Report it there — it is the quickest way to get it fixed.
polski: Wszystko, co aktualne, jest tam najpierw: co zmieniła ostatnia aktualizacja, kiedy serwer ma przerwę techniczną, i ludzie, którzy odpowiedzą szybciej, niż zdążysz poszukać. Znalazłeś błąd? Zgłoś go tam — to najszybsza droga do poprawki.
translation: 최신 소식은 다 거기 먼저 올라와: 지난 업데이트에서 바뀐 것, 서버 점검 시간, 그리고 네가 검색하는 것보다 빨리 답해 줄 사람들. 버그를 찾았어? 거기에 알려 줘 — 가장 빨리 고쳐지는 방법이야.

english: These three numbers decide how quickly the whole server moves. 100% is exactly how the game was made — higher means faster. Saving restarts the game server, so anyone playing gets dropped for a moment.
polski: Te trzy liczby decydują, jak szybko toczy się cały serwer. 100% to dokładnie tak, jak gra została stworzona — wyżej znaczy szybciej. Zapis restartuje serwer gry, więc grający zostają na chwilę rozłączeni.
translation: 이 세 숫자가 서버 전체의 속도를 정해. 100%는 원래 게임 그대로이고, 높을수록 빨라. 저장하면 게임 서버가 재시작돼서 플레이 중인 사람은 잠깐 끊겨.

english: How many monsters stand at each spawn point: ×1 = as in the game, ×2 = twice as many, up to ×4. No restart needed and kept across one; the extra monsters come at each spot's next respawn (stones and bosses after their own respawn time, usually 15-25 minutes). Metin stones, bosses and ordinary monsters each have their own. NPCs (ore veins and herb bushes too), portals, dungeons and a quest's one-off spawns are left alone.
polski: Ile potworów stoi w każdym miejscu respu: ×1 = jak w grze, ×2 = dwa razy więcej, aż do ×4. Nie trzeba restartu, a po restarcie ustawienie zostaje; dodatkowe potwory dochodzą przy najbliższym respie danego miejsca (Metiny i bossowie po swoim czasie odradzania, zwykle 15–25 minut). Osobno dla Metinów, bossów i zwykłych potworów. Postacie niezależne (także żyły rud i krzaki ziół), portale, lochy i jednorazowe respy z misji zostają bez zmian.
translation: 각 출현 지점에 서는 몬스터 수: ×1 = 게임 그대로, ×2 = 두 배, 최대 ×4. 재시작이 필요 없고 재시작 후에도 유지돼. 추가 몬스터는 각 지점의 다음 리젠 때 나와 (메틴석과 보스는 각자의 리젠 시간 후, 보통 15-25분). 메틴석, 보스, 일반 몬스터가 각각 따로 있어. NPC(광맥과 약초 덤불 포함), 포털, 던전, 퀘스트의 일회성 출현은 그대로야.
notes: T['count_help'] / panel: module text | the classic web panel (browser, UTF-8: any letter)

english: The Apprentice Chest chain (from Apprentice Chest I to the Grand Master Chest: potions, elixirs, green stones and the next chest) - one switch for players and bots. On: a player's new character gets it at its first login (up to level 5), a bot has its own from the start and opens the next chests at their levels. Off: nobody gets it; the bots lose the unopened chests of the chain and new bots are made without one. Players' chests are never touched. A change is live at once and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_STARTER_CHEST in .env).
polski: Łańcuch Skrzyń Ucznia (od Skrzyni Ucznia I po Skrzynię Arcymistrza: mikstury, eliksiry, zielone kamienie i następna skrzynia) — jeden przełącznik dla graczy i botów. Włączona: nowa postać gracza dostaje ją przy pierwszym logowaniu (do 5. poziomu), bot ma swoją od początku i otwiera kolejne skrzynie na ich poziomach. Wyłączona: nie dostaje jej nikt; boty tracą nieotwarte skrzynie z łańcucha, a nowe boty rodzą się bez niej. Skrzyń graczy nic nie rusza. Zmiana działa od razu i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_STARTER_CHEST w .env).
translation: 견습생 상자 연쇄 (견습생 상자 I부터 대가의 상자까지: 물약, 엘릭서, 초록 돌, 다음 상자) - 플레이어와 봇 공용 스위치 하나. 켜짐: 플레이어의 새 캐릭터는 첫 로그인 때 받고 (레벨 5까지), 봇은 처음부터 갖고 있다가 해당 레벨에 다음 상자를 열어. 꺼짐: 아무도 받지 않고, 봇은 연쇄의 미개봉 상자를 잃고 새 봇은 없이 만들어져. 플레이어의 상자는 절대 건드리지 않아. 변경은 즉시 적용되고 런처(DIFFICULTY 버튼, .env의 M2_STARTER_CHEST)에서 바꿀 때까지 재시작 후에도 유지돼.

english: This field shows the saved setting. 100% = standard strength without an extra bonus; 115% = 15% more attack before defence. This affects monster attacks against players and bots without increasing PvP strength. Special scripted damage may bypass this multiplier; the engine minimum damage still applies. polski: Pole pokazuje zapisane ustawienie. 100% = standardowa siła, bez dodatkowego bonusu; 115% = atak większy o 15% przed obroną. Dotyczy ataków potworów na graczy i boty, bez zwiększania siły PvP. Specjalne obrażenia zadawane skryptem mogą omijać ten mnożnik; minimalne obrażenia silnika nadal obowiązują. Zmiana zadziała po pełnym zatrzymaniu i ponownym uruchomieniu serwera gry (STOP, potem GRAJ). Sam restart kanału nie wystarczy. Zapis nie restartuje serwera.
translation: 이 칸은 저장된 설정을 보여줘. 100% = 추가 보너스 없는 기본 힘, 115% = 방어 전 공격력 15% 증가. 플레이어와 봇을 향한 몬스터 공격에만 적용되고 PvP 힘은 늘지 않아. 특수 스크립트 피해는 이 배율을 무시할 수 있고, 엔진 최소 피해는 그대로 적용돼. 변경은 게임 서버를 완전히 멈췄다가 다시 시작해야 적용돼 (STOP 후 PLAY). 채널 하나만 재시작해선 안 돼. 저장해도 서버는 재시작되지 않아.

Zmiana działa od razu — także na potwory, które już stoją (zachowują ten sam procent życia) — i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_MONSTER_HP w .env).

english: Into the inventory (the default, as before): yang from monsters a player kills goes straight into their inventory. On the ground: it drops on the ground as in the original game and the player picks it up (the Z key, Auto Hunt); a worn Third Hand still collects it at once. The yang on the ground has no owner, as in the original game - anyone can pick it up, a bot included. Bots and the Companion always get their yang straight into the inventory - their economy is built on it. Changes are live without a restart and survive the next start until you change this option in the launcher (Difficulty, M2_YANG_TO_PURSE).
polski: Do ekwipunku (domyślnie, jak dotąd): yang z potworów zabitych przez gracza trafia od razu do jego ekwipunku. Na ziemię: spada na ziemię jak w oryginalnej grze, a gracz podnosi go sam (klawisz Z, Auto Łowy); Trzecia Ręka w ekwipunku nadal zbiera go od razu. Yang na ziemi nie ma właściciela, jak w oryginalnej grze - podnieść go może każdy, także bot. Boty i Towarzysz zawsze dostają yang prosto do ekwipunku - ich ekonomia jest na tym oparta. Zmiana działa na żywo bez restartu i zostaje po ponownym starcie, dopóki nie zmienisz tej opcji w launcherze (Poziom trudności, M2_YANG_TO_PURSE).
translation: 인벤토리로 (기본값, 기존대로): 플레이어가 처치한 몬스터의 냥이 바로 인벤토리로 들어가. 바닥으로: 원작처럼 바닥에 떨어지고 플레이어가 주워 (Z 키, 자동 사냥). 착용한 제3의 손은 그래도 바로 모아. 바닥의 냥은 원작처럼 주인이 없어서 누구나, 봇도 주울 수 있어. 봇과 동료는 항상 냥을 바로 인벤토리로 받아 - 그들의 경제가 거기에 기반해. 변경은 재시작 없이 적용되고 런처(난이도, M2_YANG_TO_PURSE)에서 바꿀 때까지 다음 시작에도 유지돼.

english: The official rule (the default): every point from 17 to 19 is another roll for Master - at 17 one chance in four, at 18 in three, at 19 in two - and the 20th point is a sure M1, so a skill costs 17 to 20 points and never gets stuck. The old rule (since 2.2.14): one roll at the 17th point (25%, 45% below level 35, +25% for every reset at the Old Woman); a failed one leaves the skill at 17 at every level, and only a Book of Oblivion, the Skill Reset Scroll or the Old Woman (up to level 30) move it on. Under both, the scroll makes the next 17th point a sure Master. Bots and the Companion play the same rule. Changes are live without a restart and survive the next start until you change this option in the launcher (Difficulty, M2_SKILL_STUCK_17).
polski: Oficjalna zasada (domyślnie): każdy punkt od 17 do 19 to kolejny rzut na Mistrza - przy 17 jedna szansa na cztery, przy 18 na trzy, przy 19 na dwie - a 20. punkt daje M1 na pewno, więc umiejętność kosztuje od 17 do 20 punktów i nigdy nie utyka. Stara zasada (od 2.2.14): jeden rzut przy 17. punkcie (25%, 45% poniżej 35 poziomu, +25% za każdy reset u Starszej Pani); po porażce umiejętność stoi na 17 na każdym poziomie, a dalej prowadzi tylko Księga Zapomnienia, Zwój Powrotu Umiejętności albo Starsza Pani (do 30 poziomu). W obu zasadach zwój daje pewnego Mistrza przy następnym 17. punkcie. Boty i Towarzysz grają tą samą zasadą. Zmiana działa na żywo bez restartu i zostaje po ponownym starcie, dopóki nie zmienisz tej opcji w launcherze (Poziom trudności, M2_SKILL_STUCK_17).
translation: 공식 규칙 (기본값): 17~19의 각 포인트가 마스터 판정이야 - 17에서 1/4, 18에서 1/3, 19에서 1/2 - 그리고 20포인트는 확정 M1이라 스킬은 17~20포인트가 들고 절대 막히지 않아. 옛 규칙 (2.2.14부터): 17포인트에서 한 번만 판정 (25%, 레벨 35 미만 45%, 노파에게 초기화할 때마다 +25%). 실패하면 어느 레벨이든 17에 머물고, 망각의 책, 스킬 초기화 주문서, 노파(레벨 30까지)만 진행시킬 수 있어. 두 경우 모두 주문서를 쓰면 다음 17포인트가 확정 마스터야. 봇과 동료도 같은 규칙을 따라. 변경은 재시작 없이 적용되고 런처(난이도, M2_SKILL_STUCK_17)에서 바꿀 때까지 다음 시작에도 유지돼.

Bots and Companions never enter it, whatever this says. Closing it is live without a restart and ends the runs in progress (the players go back to the Grotto); the choice survives the next start until you change this option in the launcher (Difficulty, M2_BERAN).

Boty i Towarzysze nigdy tam nie wchodzą, bez względu na to ustawienie. english: On by default: the owner of a companion may play it himself as an ordinary player (the P window, Management, "Play your companion") and go back to his own character with "Back to your character" or /towarzysz wroc; a logout or a login of the owner's account ends it as well. Only in a world on this computer with COOP off - on a VPS and for friends the server refuses, unless "Public servers" below is on. A GM character cannot. The change is live at once and stays across a restart until M2_SIDEKICK_PLAY in .env is changed.
polski: Domyślnie włączone: właściciel Towarzysza może zagrać nim sam jak zwykły gracz (okno P, Zarządzanie, „Graj Towarzyszem”) i wrócić na swoją postać przyciskiem „Wróć do swojej postaci” lub komendą /towarzysz wroc; wylogowanie albo logowanie na konto właściciela kończy to samo. Tylko w świecie na tym komputerze z wyłączonym COOP — na VPS i u znajomych serwer odmawia, chyba że włączysz poniżej „Serwery publiczne”. Postać GM nie może. Zmiana działa od razu i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz M2_SIDEKICK_PLAY w .env.
translation: 기본은 켜짐: 동료의 주인은 일반 플레이어처럼 직접 동료를 플레이할 수 있고 (P 창, 관리, "동료로 플레이"), "내 캐릭터로 돌아가기"나 /towarzysz wroc로 자기 캐릭터로 돌아가. 주인 계정의 로그아웃이나 로그인으로도 끝나. COOP가 꺼진 이 컴퓨터의 월드에서만 가능해 - VPS나 친구용 서버에서는 아래 "공개 서버"를 켜지 않으면 서버가 거부해. GM 캐릭터는 안 돼. 변경은 즉시 적용되고 .env의 M2_SIDEKICK_PLAY를 바꿀 때까지 재시작 후에도 유지돼.
notes: T['skp_help'] | the classic web panel (browser, UTF-8: any letter)

english: The owner's character plays beside him as a helper: it follows the player, fights beside him and gains experience in his party, drinks potions, picks up its own drop only and stands up after a death. It never changes its equipment, spends no points, does not trade, spends no yang, does no quests, writes nothing in the chat and never goes to another core.
polski: Postać właściciela gra obok jako pomocnik: idzie za graczem, walczy obok i zdobywa doświadczenie w jego drużynie, pije mikstury, zbiera tylko swój drop i wstaje po śmierci. Nigdy nie zmienia ekwipunku, nie rozdaje punktów, nie handluje, nie wydaje yang, nie robi questów, nie pisze na czacie i nie przechodzi na inny rdzeń.
translation: 주인의 캐릭터가 옆에서 도우미로 플레이해: 플레이어를 따라다니고 함께 싸우며 파티에서 경험치를 얻고, 물약을 마시고, 자기 드롭만 줍고, 죽으면 일어나. 장비는 절대 바꾸지 않고, 포인트를 쓰지 않고, 거래하지 않고, 냥을 쓰지 않고, 퀘스트를 하지 않고, 채팅에 아무것도 쓰지 않으며 다른 코어로 가지 않아.

english: Public servers (a VPS, COOP, the community server): by default playing your companion works only in a world on this computer. Switching this on allows it for players who connect from outside too. Every other gate stays: the owner only, a one-time login password valid 60 seconds and accepted only from the owner's address, no bot account password ever in a client. The helper gives a player a second character in a fight - on a public server you can switch it off on its own.
polski: Serwery publiczne (VPS, COOP, serwer społeczności): domyślnie granie Towarzyszem działa tylko w świecie na tym komputerze. Włączenie pozwala na nie także graczom, którzy łączą się z zewnątrz. Każda inna bramka zostaje: tylko właściciel, jednorazowe hasło logowania ważne 60 sekund i przyjęte tylko z adresu właściciela, żadnego hasła konta bota u klienta. Pomocnik daje graczowi drugą postać w walce - na serwerze publicznym możesz go wyłączyć osobno.
translation: 공개 서버 (VPS, COOP, 커뮤니티 서버): 기본적으로 동료 플레이는 이 컴퓨터의 월드에서만 돼. 켜면 외부에서 접속하는 플레이어도 쓸 수 있어. 다른 제한은 모두 유지돼: 주인만, 60초 동안 유효하고 주인 주소에서만 받는 일회용 로그인 비밀번호, 클라이언트에 봇 계정 비밀번호는 절대 없음. 도우미는 전투에서 플레이어에게 두 번째 캐릭터를 줘 - 공개 서버에서는 따로 끌 수 있어.

english: Over the name of a player whose Auto Hunt is on, others see [AUTO]; a player with no movement, fight, chat, item, trade or window for the given minutes gets [AFK], which goes at the first action. Bots and companions have their own statuses and get neither. "Game masters only": the server sends the mark to the characters on the GM list alone, nobody else receives it. The change is live within 15 seconds, with no restart, and stays across a restart. It needs the client of this version (an older client draws nothing). Kiciamol's idea.
polski: Nad nickiem gracza, który ma włączone Auto Łowy, inni widzą [AUTO]; gracz bez ruchu, walki, czatu, przedmiotów, handlu i okien przez podaną liczbę minut dostaje [AFK], który znika przy pierwszej akcji. Monster drops only - shops, quest rewards, chests and the ItemShop stay as they are. The bots drop bonused gear more often too and put it on their stalls. english: The game takes part of the drop chance from a character above its monster: two levels over 98% of the chance is left, five over 92%, ten over half (a boss and a Metin stone 30%), fifteen and more over 1%. This setting is the least share of the chance a kill keeps whatever the level difference: 0% = the game's own penalty (the default), 100% = no penalty, anything between a floor (at 25% a character fifteen levels over drops at a quarter of the chance). It never lowers a chance, so a character under its monster or at its level drops as before, and the drop rate and the drop bonuses act on the result as they always did. It covers the whole drop of a kill - items, drop groups, Metin stones, bosses and books - for players and bots alike; yang and experience stay as they are. The client Wiki's note on the level penalty describes the game without this setting. A change applies from the next kill, without a restart, and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_DROP_LEVEL_FLOOR_PCT in .env).
polski: Gra zabiera część szansy na drop postaci wyższej od potwora: 2 poziomy wyżej zostaje 98% szansy, 5 wyżej 92%, 10 wyżej połowa (boss i Metin 30%), 15 i więcej wyżej 1%. To ustawienie to najmniejsza część szansy, jaką zabicie zachowuje bez względu na różnicę poziomów: 0% = kara jak w grze (domyślnie), 100% = bez kary, pomiędzy = podłoga (przy 25% postać 15 poziomów wyżej dropi z jedną czwartą szansy). Nigdy nie obniża szansy, więc postać niższa od potwora albo na jego poziomie dropi jak dotąd, a stawka dropu i bonusy do dropu działają na wynik jak zawsze. Dotyczy całego dropu z zabicia — przedmiotów, grup dropu, Metinów, bossów i ksiąg — u graczy i botów tak samo; yang i doświadczenie bez zmian. Notatka o karze za poziom w Wiki klienta opisuje grę bez tego ustawienia. Zmiana działa od następnego zabicia, bez restartu, i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_DROP_LEVEL_FLOOR_PCT w .env).

english: How fast the players' characters and the bots move, the Companion with them: a percent of the game's own speed, 100% = as in the game. The character window shows the speed with this percent (at 50% a character of 120 reads 60). Boty chodzą w tym samym tempie co gracze, a Towarzysz nadąża za swoim graczem; potwory poruszają się jak w grze. Okno postaci pokazuje szybkość z tym procentem (przy 50% postać ze 120 ma 60). english: How many Cor Draconis a day the Power of the Dragon Eye gives at the Alchemist (10 = as in the game; one fewer on the day of the first hand-in) and the extra drops of Metin stones and bosses for players, as a percent of kills (0 = off): Dragon Stones (1-5 shards from a Metin by its level, a Cor Draconis from a boss, two from the strongest; from level 30 and only with the Alchemy on) and Kupon SM (10 to 500 Dragon Coins by the Metin's level, a value or two more from a boss, up to 5000 from the strongest of level 105; the smaller ones more often, so a kill is worth as many coins on average as before). Nothing for a character more than 15 levels over the victim and nothing for the bots; a Companion's kill counts for its owner. The bots get the same Cor Draconis a day as the players. A change is live at once and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_DS_EYES_PER_DAY, M2_EXTRA_DS_DROP and M2_EXTRA_COUPON_DROP in .env).
polski: Ile Cor Draconis dziennie daje Moc Smoczego Oka u Alchemika (10 = jak w grze; w dniu pierwszego oddania o jeden mniej) i dodatkowy drop z Metinów i bossów dla graczy, w procentach zabić (0 = wyłączony): Smocze Kamienie (1-5 odłamków z Metina zależnie od jego poziomu, Cor Draconis z bossa, dwa z najsilniejszych; od 30 poziomu i tylko przy włączonej Alchemii) i kupony SM (od 10 do 500 Smoczych Monet zależnie od poziomu Metina, z bossa o jeden lub dwa nominały więcej, aż do 5000 z najsilniejszego od 105 poziomu; mniejsze częściej, więc średnio zabicie daje tyle monet co dawniej). Nic dla postaci silniejszej od przeciwnika o więcej niż 15 poziomów i nic dla botów; zabicie Towarzysza liczy się jego właścicielowi. Boty dostają tyle samo Cor Draconis dziennie co gracze. Zmiana działa od razu i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_DS_EYES_PER_DAY, M2_EXTRA_DS_DROP i M2_EXTRA_COUPON_DROP w .env).
translation: 연금술사에게서 용안의 힘이 하루에 주는 Cor Draconis 수 (10 = 게임 그대로, 첫 제출일엔 하나 적음)와 플레이어용 메틴석·보스 추가 드롭, 처치 대비 퍼센트 (0 = 끔): 용혼석 (메틴석 레벨에 따라 조각 1-5개, 보스에게서 Cor Draconis 1개, 가장 강한 보스에게서 2개, 레벨 30부터이며 연금술이 켜졌을 때만)과 Kupon SM (메틴석 레벨에 따라 드래곤 코인 10~500, 보스는 한두 단계 더 높고, 레벨 105 최강 보스는 최대 5000, 작은 것이 더 자주 나와서 처치당 평균 코인은 예전과 같아). 희생자보다 15레벨 넘게 높은 캐릭터와 봇은 받지 않고, 동료의 처치는 주인 몫이야. 봇은 하루 Cor Draconis를 플레이어와 같이 받아. 변경은 즉시 적용되고 런처(DIFFICULTY 버튼, .env의 M2_DS_EYES_PER_DAY, M2_EXTRA_DS_DROP, M2_EXTRA_COUPON_DROP)에서 바꿀 때까지 재시작 후에도 유지돼.

english: The Alchemist in every kingdom's first village: from level 30 a letter to him, shards from monsters, Cor Draconis and the Alchemy window (the button in the inventory and the O key). On: it works for players and bots. Off: nobody gets the letter, a shard or a Cor Draconis, the Alchemist has none of his options, the bots take no part, and a player's client hides the Alchemy button in the inventory and opens no window on O; the stones and boxes a character holds stay its own. A change is live at once - a player's client in the game learns of it within a few seconds, and the Alchemist's letter and arrow go with the button - and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_DRAGON_SOUL in .env).
polski: Alchemik w pierwszej wiosce każdego królestwa: od 30 poziomu list do niego, odłamki z potworów, Cor Draconis i okno Alchemii (przycisk w ekwipunku i klawisz O). Włączona: działa dla graczy i botów. Wyłączona: nikt nie dostaje listu, odłamka ani Cor Draconis, Alchemik nie ma swoich opcji, boty nie biorą w niej udziału, a klient gracza chowa przycisk Alchemii w ekwipunku i nie otwiera jej okna klawiszem O; kamienie i skrzynie, które postać ma, zostają jej. Zmiana działa od razu — klient gracza w grze dowiaduje się o niej w ciągu kilku sekund, a list i strzałka do Alchemika znikają razem z przyciskiem — i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_DRAGON_SOUL w .env).
translation: 각 왕국 첫 마을의 연금술사: 레벨 30부터 그에게 가는 편지, 몬스터의 조각, Cor Draconis, 연금술 창 (인벤토리 버튼과 O 키). 켜짐: 플레이어와 봇 모두 사용. 꺼짐: 아무도 편지, 조각, Cor Draconis를 받지 않고, 연금술사의 기능이 모두 없어지고, 봇은 참여하지 않으며, 플레이어 클라이언트는 인벤토리의 연금술 버튼을 숨기고 O로 창을 열지 않아. 캐릭터가 가진 돌과 상자는 그대로 남아. 변경은 즉시 적용되고 - 게임 중인 플레이어 클라이언트는 몇 초 안에 알게 되고, 연금술사의 편지와 화살표도 버튼과 함께 사라져 - 런처(DIFFICULTY 버튼, .env의 M2_DRAGON_SOUL)에서 바꿀 때까지 재시작 후에도 유지돼.

english: How many game channels the server runs. With two, some of the bots play on CH2, so the server spreads them over two CPU cores and carries more bots at once. Every shop, bots' and players', stands on CH1: a bot on CH2 that wants to open or serve its shop or to buy something moves to CH1, and a free bot of CH1 moves to CH2 in its place. The share set here is the least CH2 carries; with nobody waiting to move, CH2 may take up to ten points more. With three and four, CH3 (and CH4) carry fresh bots from level one besides: characters of their own, 500 a kingdom, made at the first start with this setting. They never move to CH1 or CH2, and the bots of CH1 and CH2 never come to theirs; there are no shops, bot guilds, wars, tower or events on CH3 and CH4. One channel by default.
polski: Ile kanałów gry uruchamia serwer. Przy dwóch część botów gra na CH2, więc serwer rozkłada je na dwa rdzenie procesora i udźwignie więcej botów naraz. Wszystkie sklepy (botów i graczy) stoją tylko na CH1: bot z CH2, który chce otworzyć albo obsłużyć swój sklep albo coś kupić, przechodzi na CH1, a wolny bot z CH1 przechodzi na jego miejsce na CH2. Ustawiony udział to najmniej tyle botów na CH2; gdy nikt nie czeka na przejście, CH2 może przejąć do 10 punktów więcej. Przy trzech i czterech na CH3 (i CH4) grają do tego świeże boty od 1 poziomu: osobne postacie, po 500 na królestwo, tworzone przy pierwszym starcie z tym ustawieniem. Nie przechodzą na CH1 i CH2, a boty z CH1 i CH2 nie przychodzą do nich; na CH3 i CH4 nie ma sklepów, gildii botów, wojen, Wieży ani wydarzeń. Domyślnie jeden kanał.
translation: 서버가 돌리는 게임 채널 수. 두 개면 봇 일부가 CH2에서 플레이해서, 서버가 CPU 코어 두 개에 나눠 한 번에 더 많은 봇을 감당해. 봇과 플레이어의 모든 상점은 CH1에 있어: CH2의 봇이 상점을 열거나 관리하거나 뭔가를 사려면 CH1로 가고, CH1의 한가한 봇이 대신 CH2로 가. 여기 설정한 비율은 CH2의 최소치이고, 이동 대기 중인 봇이 없으면 CH2가 최대 10포인트 더 가질 수 있어. 세 개와 네 개면 CH3 (와 CH4)에 레벨 1부터 시작하는 새 봇도 있어: 이 설정으로 첫 시작 때 만들어지는 왕국당 500명의 자체 캐릭터. 이들은 CH1이나 CH2로 가지 않고, CH1과 CH2의 봇도 그쪽으로 오지 않아. CH3과 CH4에는 상점, 봇 길드, 전쟁, 탑, 이벤트가 없어. 기본은 채널 하나야.
